title: NbSn2: quantum oscillations vs torque magnetometry
summary: Orthorhombic NbSn2 (Fddd): the extremal orbits of spin-orbit and scalar-relativistic pyskeaf runs (bundled, compressed) compared with a torque rotation from [001] to [110] with PAOFLOW.agentic.qo_analysis: Fermi-surface inventory, digitised experimental FFT map, branch assignment, field directions, SOC vs scalar-relativistic, Fermi-level scan, breakdown gaps, weak peaks and a collaborator package. No QE or PAOFLOW run is needed.

steps.label: Spin-orbit analysis against the torque rotation
steps.note: about 1.5 minutes; results in qo_analysis_soc/ (RUN_NETWORK = True in main.py adds the breakdown network, about 15 min on 24 cores)

steps.label: Scalar-relativistic run and its convergence (81^3 vs 49^3)
